segments.name: Cardiovascular
segments.description: Manufactures medical devices for vascular access and minimally invasive treatment of heart, peripheral vessel and organ diseases for physicians and hospitals.
segments.evidence: We conduct our business through two operating segments: cardiovascular and endoscopy.

segments.name: Endoscopy
segments.description: Provides endoscopic devices for gastroenterology and pulmonary procedures, including stents, dilation balloons and ablation technology.
segments.evidence: The products in our endoscopy operating segment, Merit Medical Endotek ® , are organized in two product portfolios: gastroenterology and pulmonary.

revenueModel.text: Merit sells medical devices to end-user physicians, hospitals, alternate site facilities, buying groups and healthcare networks in the U.S., and to distributors and custom procedure tray manufacturers internationally.
revenueModel.evidence: In the U.S., we have dedicated, direct sales organizations primarily focused on selling to end-user physicians, hospitals and alternate site facilities (e.g., office-based labs), major buying groups and integrated healthcare networks.

changes.text: In 2025, Merit reorganized its sales teams and product categories to include spine products under its OEM product category.
changes.evidence: In 2025, we reorganized our sales teams and product categories to include our spine products under our OEM product category.
